Once-daily dosage regimens, usually given at night, are suitable for amoxapine up to 300 mg daily; divided-dosage regimens are recommended for doses above 300 mg daily. It has been claimed that, in the treatment of depression, amoxap- ine has a more rapid onset of action than amitriptyline or imi- pramine with a clinical effect possibly appearing 4 to 7 days after starting therapy, although this has been disputed. Amoxapine should be withdrawn gradually to reduce the risk of withdrawal symptoms. Amoxapine has also been investigated for its potential as an an- tipsychotic. ◊ References. 1. Jue SG, et al.
